cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: A container with a handle and an opening for pouring drinks. There is water in the pitcher.
A part of an object that you hold to carry or use it. Hold the cup by its handle.
A light material that can be made into many shapes. This cup is made of plastic.
A hard material such as iron, steel or gold. The spoon is made of metal.
To damage something so that it separates into pieces or stops working. Be careful not to break the glass.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.
